Asha_CS: Quick flag — NeptuneLabs (Enterprise) embed traffic dropped ~61% over past 11 days. Renewal in ~6w. Procurement reached out asking for a direct perf & cost head-to-head vs OtherModel. Their technical champion left last sprint. Need triage + retention plan. @Dmitri_CSM @Renee_SE can we coordinate?

Dmitri_CSM: Ack. Paste dashboard link and top-level deltas please. Any license freezes or billing alerts?

Asha_CS: Dashboard: https://redwood.app/accounts/neptunelabs/overview — embeddings -61% WoW, gen calls -18%, active API tokens -36%. No 5xx increase; seeing intermittent 429 bursts on peak windows. No billing holds yet but procurement is requesting competitor numbers.

Renee_SE: Any recent model variant or SDK changes noted? Embeds usually tank when a quantized variant is ramped or prefix caching is invalidated.

Asha_CS: Timeline shows a routing change to `nl-embed-lite-q` rolled to 50% on 2026-08-04 and a client SDK patch on 2026-08-05.

Renee_SE: Likely culprit. I'll pull KV hit rates, batching histograms, and per-route token length distribution. Quick self-check we can give them: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/accounts/NEPTUNE/kv_hits`

Ivy_Product: I'll prepare a 1-page comparison (our current embed variant vs OtherModel) using their actual traffic slice and include expected latency + cost deltas. Also include rollback impact if perf gap >20%.

Hector_RevOps: We can approve a 14-day targeted reserved pool for their main embed route up to $9k or a one-time invoice credit. Need acct id + most recent invoice to issue. Legal will review terms for any pilot.

Dmitri_CSM: Outreach plan: 25-min readout with procurement, eng, and the new PM. Offer private trial + reserved pool, present tailored perf/cost comparison, and propose a short re-onboard/workshop for their new PM.

Renee_SE: On the call I'll have a quick heatmap + KV hit slides and a live demo of rolling back variant to show expected recovery. For quick self-diagnosis we'll give them: `curl -X GET -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage/summary?account=NEPTUNELABS`

Asha_CS: Draft outreach: "Hi team — we noticed embed volume dropped and procurement asked for a benchmark. Can we schedule 25 minutes to share a tailored perf & cost readout, a mitigation bundle (14-day reserved pool + trial), and a short remediation plan? Tue/Wed next week? — Asha"

Dmitri_CSM: Add: "we'll run the comparison on your traffic so it's apples-to-apples" to deflect price-only discussions.

Ivy_Product: ETA for slide: 6 hours. I'll also add a simple expected delta table for rollback vs tuning.

Hector_RevOps: Sent last invoice INV-12022 to Asha. Legal looped for pilot/promo T&Cs. Marking renewal-risk and urgent.

Asha_CS: Scheduling Tue 9am PT readout and will update with meeting outcome. Marking as renewal-risk in CRM.
